scopedCoverageNotes.text: Every local named-candidate contest on the official November 3, 2026 county sample ballot has been checked. District Court candidates apply only to their named electoral districts. Local ballot measures are still being collected.

sources.reviewedEvidence: Complete official November3,2026 general candidate list,97 contests153 names. Deterministic heading/ballotname extraction retains all official printed names. Local categories contain42 candidate races52 choices:county7,appeals2,districtcourt25,city8. Every local name independently matches the actual all-contests sample. Generic write-in blanks excluded.

Actual complete12-page Official General and Special Election Ballot November3,2026. Header explicitly says it contains all races and measures in KingCounty, and voters may not be eligible for some races/measures. Complete local candidate choice lists compared to official current candidate list:all52 names match. District electors never widened to county.
Current official2026 November GeneralElection page links the acquired candidate list, sample ballot and election notice directly.
Official November3,2026 election notice names the complete offices/measures called; retained as coverage evidence.

Current official DistrictCourt of KingCounty GIS catalog states these are divisions for purposes of election, defines Northeast NE,Southeast SE,Shoreline SH,Southwest SW,West W and links exact ArcGIS feature service. Metadata lastmodifiedAugust26,2026. Administrative courthouse divisions are not substituted for electoral districts.
Official-linked GIS FeatureLayer KingCountyDistrictCourts exposes polygon geometry and juddst/NAME fields. Used to map each exact named electoral district to its source-backed division identity.

Full official-linked current GeoJSON response contains all5 electoral polygons, exact official codes NE,SE,SH,SW,W and names. Geometry is preserved without widening or county clipping; Southeast includes applicable PierceCounty areas. Source-backed precise OCD identities prepared with matching source feature; reader installation remains River dependency.

RCW2.06.020(1)(a) explicitly states CourtOfAppeals Division1 District1 shall consist of KingCounty. Both named judge positions5/6 are therefore scoped to the exact KingCounty electorate, not the whole Division1.
